body.en: Electric 60 vs Electric 80 Concrete Pump Electric 60 and Electric 80 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. The 900 m figure is not a fourth row on the Electric 60 page. Theoretical output: Electric 60 lists 40 m³/h; Electric 80 lists 60 m³/h. Main unit weight: Electric 60 lists 3300 kg; Electric 80 lists 6000 kg. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Electric 80 lists cells that Electric 60 does not: Model line Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110; Pumping distance (H / V) 900 m / 300 m; Max. aggregate size 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). One page splits distance by stone size. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. Does Electric 60 list the same motor power as Electric 80? Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other. Electric 80 lists 60 m³/h. No. Electric 60 lists 35 MPa. The Electric 80 page does not list that label. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.

question.en: Does Electric 60 list the same motor power as Electric 80?
question.zh: 电动60和电动80的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 60 lists 90 kW. Electric 80 lists 110 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动60印 90 kW。电动80印 110 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。
